<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require 'bootstrap.php';
require 'tests/Integration/PostgreSqlTestDatabase.php';
$db = Tests\Integration\PostgreSqlTestDatabase::fromEnvironment();
$db->create();
$s = new App\Platform\Storage\PostgreSQLStorage($db->host, $db->port, $db->database, $db->username, $db->password, $db->schema);
$out = [];
try {
    $s->execute('CREATE TABLE tx_records (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)');
    try {
        $out['caught_sql_error_result'] = $s->transaction(static function () use ($s): string {
            $s->execute('INSERT INTO tx_records VALUES (1)');
            try { $s->execute('INSERT INTO tx_records VALUES (1)'); } catch (App\Platform\Storage\StorageException) {}
            return 'success';
        });
    } catch (Throwable $e) { $out['caught_sql_error_result'] = $e::class; }
    $out['rows_after_reported_success'] = $s->query('SELECT id FROM tx_records');
    $s->execute('CREATE TABLE deferred_records (id INTEGER UNIQUE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)');
    try {
        $s->transaction(static fn(): bool => $s->execute('INSERT INTO deferred_records VALUES (1), (1)'));
    } catch (Throwable $e) { $out['deferred_commit_error'] = ['class'=>$e::class, 'code'=>$e->getCode(), 'message'=>$e->getMessage()]; }
    $repo = new App\Platform\Storage\Migration\MigrationRepository($s);
    $migration = new class implements App\Platform\Storage\Migration\Migration {
        public function getVersion(): string { return 'broken-up'; }
        public function up(): string { return 'CREATE TABLE partial_up (id INTEGER); ALTER TABLE missing_table ADD value TEXT;'; }
        public function down(): string { return 'DROP TABLE partial_up;'; }
    };
    $service = new App\Platform\Storage\Migration\MigrationService($s, $repo, new App\Platform\Storage\Migration\MigrationLoader('', new App\Platform\Logging\ReadableOutputLogger()));
    $service->addMigration($migration);
    try { $service->migrate(); } catch (Throwable $e) { $out['migration_up_error'] = $e::class; }
    $out['table_left_after_failed_up'] = $s->queryOne("SELECT to_regclass('partial_up') IS NOT NULL AS present");
    $out['versions_after_failed_up'] = $repo->getExecutedMigrations();
    $s->execute('CREATE TABLE partial_down (id INTEGER)');
    $repo->add('broken-down');
    $migration = new class implements App\Platform\Storage\Migration\Migration {
        public function getVersion(): string { return 'broken-down'; }
        public function up(): string { return ''; }
        public function down(): string { return 'DROP TABLE partial_down; ALTER TABLE missing_table ADD value TEXT;'; }
    };
    $service = new App\Platform\Storage\Migration\MigrationService($s, $repo, new App\Platform\Storage\Migration\MigrationLoader('', new App\Platform\Logging\ReadableOutputLogger()));
    $service->addMigration($migration);
    try { $service->rollback(); } catch (Throwable $e) { $out['migration_down_error'] = $e::class; }
    $out['table_left_after_failed_down'] = $s->queryOne("SELECT to_regclass('partial_down') IS NOT NULL AS present");
    $out['versions_after_failed_down'] = $repo->getExecutedMigrations();
    echo json_encode($out, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR|JSON_PRETTY_PRINT), PHP_EOL;
} finally { $db->cleanup(); }
